::: cover variant=masthead kicker="Internal memo"
To: All staff at the north site (example) · From: Facilities team · Subject: visitor parking
:::

# What changes

From Monday 1 November, visitors no longer park in the front row of the north car park. The front row becomes a drop-off and loading zone with a 15-minute limit. Visitor parking moves to the 24 marked bays on level 1 of the multi-storey car park, next to the east entrance.

We are making this change because delivery vans now arrive at the front row about 60 times a day, up from 25 a year ago. Vans waiting in the access road have blocked the fire lane four times since July.

::: callout kind=warning title="Fire lane"
The access road in front of reception is a fire lane. Do not ask visitors to wait there, even for a few minutes. Security will ask any parked vehicle to move.
:::

# What you need to do

1. If you are expecting a visitor after 1 November, register them in the visitor system at least one working day ahead. The system now issues a level 1 parking code with the invitation email.
2. Tell your visitor to follow the "Visitor parking" signs from the roundabout instead of turning into the front row.
3. Meet your visitor at the east entrance. Reception will still print badges, but visitors will reach reception through the east corridor.

Visitors with a blue badge keep using the four accessible bays beside reception. Nothing changes for them.

# Numbers behind the decision

Table 1. Front-row use, one year apart (example data)

| Measure (example) | Oct 2025 | Sep 2026 |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Delivery van arrivals per day | 25 | 60 |
| Average visitor arrivals per day | 41 | 38 |
| Fire lane obstructions reported | 0 | 4 |

Level 1 has 24 visitor bays, which covers the busiest day this year (33 visitors, of whom 22 arrived by car).

# Questions

Ask the facilities desk on extension 4410 (example) or reply to this memo. We will review the new arrangement at the end of January and report back to all staff.
